summary.text: Chris Campbell is a Democratic state representative who represents Indiana House District 26, has served since 2018, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Chris Campbell was born in Indiana and earned a bachelor's degree in speech and audiology in 1990 and a master's degree in audiology in 1992, both from Purdue University.
Her professional experience includes working as an audiologist, and her organizational affiliations include the ACLU, the League of Women Voters and the West Lafayette Redevelopment Commission.
Campbell assumed office on November 7, 2018, succeeding Sally Siegrist, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Government and Regulatory Reform, Insurance, and Ways and Means committees.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Campbell said she was born in LaPorte, has been married for 36 years, raised two children in Tippecanoe County, and recently retired from her career as a local audiologist.
She listed economic balance and affordability, including the costs of childcare, healthcare, housing and food security, as well as investing in public education, among her key campaign messages.
